manualReview: Required separately in v2-pack-certification.md; this is mathematical evidence only.

rows.name: First steps
rows.lesson: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Reach the goal. You and the world are both white, so you match.

rows.name: Two colours
rows.lesson: A prism sets YOUR colour. A dial sets the WORLD colour. Enter the goal while the two match.

rows.name: Conveyor
rows.lesson: Enter an arrow floor: its arrow names the exit, and the belt chain carries you without extra strokes.

rows.name: Loader
rows.lesson: Walk into a crate to push it. A receiver lights while a crate of its colour touches it from any side.

rows.name: Keys and masters
rows.lesson: Use the key to latch the exit link. The optional master switch forces every linked gate shut; ACTION on it toggles it back.

rows.name: Hold and release
rows.lesson: The optional plate opens its gate only while occupied; the gate closes before you can reach it. Use the latched key for the exit route.

rows.name: Hinges
rows.lesson: A phase wall is solid only while its link is unsatisfied. Same lock law, no colour test.

rows.name: Short cuts
rows.lesson: Portals are always paired. Walking into one exits from its twin.

rows.name: Cargo current
rows.lesson: Push the red crate onto the arrow floor. The belt carries its own passenger beside the receiver; take the upper detour to the gate.

rows.name: The long way round
rows.lesson: Walls never move. Crates do — push one down a corridor to open a route, or walk around it.

rows.name: Corridor
rows.lesson: Navigate the two-row corridor around the wall. The key and its upper gate are optional; the lower lane also reaches the exit.

rows.name: Colophon
rows.lesson: Combine the latched link, red prism, and set dial. The optional master switch forces linked gates shut; the spare crate is not needed.

rows.name: Void and passage
rows.lesson: Entering the master void switch makes Void tiles solid. Press ACT on the switch to restore passage, then reach the goal.

rows.name: First Push
rows.lesson: Push the crate onto the target, then take the upper detour through the gate.

rows.name: Corridor Pivot
rows.lesson: Pivot the blocking crate into its safe pocket, then take the raised detour to the gate.

rows.name: Corner Check
rows.lesson: Read the open lanes before pushing; the target pocket is safe, while the sealed corners are not routes.

rows.name: Two-Chamber Detour
rows.lesson: Open the first link, detour around the second crate, then occupy its target to reach the exit gate.

rows.name: Warehouse No. 3
rows.lesson: A classic warehouse pattern: open link 1, then sort the second crate onto its own target before the last gate.

rows.name: Long Alley Remix
rows.lesson: Push onto the target, then walk the long upper corridor; these crates can be pushed but not pulled.

rows.name: Four-Crate Shuffle
rows.lesson: Open each linked gate in order: park the blocker, sort the three target crates, then reach the exit.

rows.name: Master Warehouse
rows.lesson: Use all three links, park the blocker, and follow the final switchback to the far exit.

rows.name: First Medusa
rows.lesson: Push the shield north into the westbound ray, then cross behind it to the exit above the ray. Exposure fails the attempt; restart to try again.

rows.name: Crossfire
rows.lesson: Push north to shield both rays at their intersection. Return west through the protected crossing; the exit is beyond the ray row.

rows.name: Crossing Lines
rows.lesson: Move beneath the shield, push it north onto the ray intersection, then return west through the protected crossing.

rows.name: The Unhurried Exit
rows.lesson: Park the lower shield in the ray, then push the upper crate onto its target to open the exit gate. Both jobs matter; no timer is running.

rows.name: Four Medusas
rows.lesson: Shield both courtyard rays before crossing to the exit beyond them. The two side turrets are fixed, wall-occluded scenery.

rows.name: Still Corridor
rows.lesson: The corridor ray is fixed; move the shield into its line, then use the lower return aisle.

rows.name: Twin Chambers
rows.lesson: Park the first shield north and the second south on their targets. Cross each protected ray and its linked gate without exposure.

rows.name: Labyrinth Fortress
rows.lesson: Three shield targets open three gates. Alternate north, south, then north pushes, and cross the protected chambers; exposure ends the attempt.

rows.name: Red First, Blue Next
rows.lesson: Cross the open red barrier, ACT at the crystal, then take the blue route.

rows.name: Two-Switch Zigzag
rows.lesson: ACT at each crystal in order: blue opens the middle, then red opens the exit leg.

rows.name: Ordered Twin Chambers
rows.lesson: The first crystal opens blue; the second must restore red before the last gate.

rows.name: Switch Loop
rows.lesson: Run the polarity loop: flip blue for the middle barrier, then red for the exit.

rows.name: Palace of Darkness
rows.lesson: Route through two rooms: invert to blue for the center gate, then back to red for the exit.

rows.name: Sixteen-Column Exchange
rows.lesson: Use the five spaced crystals to exchange polarity across this 16-column corridor.

rows.name: Barrier Blocker
rows.lesson: Park the crate on the red barrier: it holds closure pending while you use the upper crystal. Flip again for the red exit; do not push past the parking cell.

rows.name: Grand Inversion
rows.lesson: Follow the five-lane maze and actuate each crystal before its paired barrier class.

rows.name: First Current
rows.lesson: Ride the eastbound belt, then step north from the safe floor stop.

rows.name: Double Circuit
rows.lesson: Each open circuit stops at a wall. Use the lower connector, then ride the second eastbound exit.

rows.name: Ice Launch
rows.lesson: Push the block across ice onto the arrow floor. Follow until the occupied exit stops you; the belt does not shove the block ahead.

rows.name: Wall Channel
rows.lesson: A northbound belt redirects the run over ice; a wall stops it safely before the eastbound exit channel.

rows.name: Compression Chamber
rows.lesson: Slide the block into the wall-bounded pocket. Nothing is crushed; the vacated cell opens the upper route.

rows.name: Long Alley
rows.lesson: Cross the full-width eastbound channel in one turn, stop on floor, then take the north exit.

rows.name: Circuit Exit
rows.lesson: Ride into the plain-floor junction. Its open circuit stops there; two deliberate south pushes park the block before the long exit lane.

rows.name: Absolute Momentum
rows.lesson: Traverse the east–north–west network and stop against the crate bumper. Leave it in place and take the northbound step into the upper exit channel.

rows.name: The White Mark
rows.lesson: White is still white here; it fills the classic yellow-key role. Take the red prism, advance the world dial to red, then pass the red aura gate.

rows.name: Two Prisms
rows.lesson: Red then blue: each prism replaces your aura. Blue persists while you return to the dial; advance it to blue before the matching goal.

rows.name: The Other Carrier
rows.lesson: The blue world gate reads W, not your red aura. Set W to blue, cross it, then take the blue prism so both carriers match at the exit.

rows.name: Guarded Spectrum
rows.lesson: Latch the key to open the phase wall and power the green set-dial. The green prism changes P; the dial changes W.

rows.name: Three-Way Filter
rows.lesson: Each aura gate tests your current P: red, then green, then blue. The final dial must leave W blue to match the last prism.

rows.name: Chromatic Corridor
rows.lesson: This corridor alternates W-gates with P-gates. Set each world color with the dial, then take the matching prism before its aura filter.

rows.name: Commit to Green
rows.lesson: At the fork, the red spur is a reversible dead end. Choose the green prism and gate to reach the upper route, then change to blue for the exit.

rows.name: Spectrum Nexus
rows.lesson: Use the white gate while P is white, then follow red, green, and blue through both P- and W-filters. White stays white; all four states remain distinct.

rows.name: First Dock
rows.lesson: Push the red crate beside the receiver; standing on it is not a dock.

rows.name: Two Colors, Two Links
rows.lesson: The red dock opens link 1; the green dock opens only link 2.

rows.name: Around the Corner
rows.lesson: Push north, walk around the corner, then push east into the guarded dock beside the red receiver.

rows.name: Belt and Barrier
rows.lesson: Push red onto the arrow floor to dock it beside the receiver. Leave it parked, take the upper detour, and cross the opened phase wall.

rows.name: Castle Basement Rooms
rows.lesson: Cross the red and green dock rooms in order; neither receiver is an occupancy plate.

rows.name: Railway Dock
rows.lesson: Push red along the upper track until it docks beside the receiver, then return by the lower exit lane.

rows.name: Re-dock the Red Crate
rows.lesson: Cross link 1 first, then re-dock the same crate on link 2 before the exit.

rows.name: Grand Dockworks
rows.lesson: Cross link 1, re-dock red on link 2, then cross link 3 while the parked blue crate keeps its receiver active.
